subject: Intercontinental workshop — slotting & calendar holds
messages:
From: Emily Chen <emily.chen@solsticeinc.com>
To: Priya Natarajan <priya_natarajan@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-09-01T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Intercontinental workshop planning

Hi Priya —

Thanks again for taking this on. Solstice is planning an executive + product workshop for our EMEA and APAC teams. We have a hard window the week of Oct 11–15 (EMEA in-office) and would like Redwood to run a half-day technical session + executive Q&A onsite in London on Oct 13, plus an afternoon virtual drop-in for APAC on Oct 14 local time.

Key asks:
- Can your team confirm availability for Oct 13 (full day slot reserved for Redwood, morning for execs + afternoon for hands-on)?
- We need calendar holds by next Tuesday so our ops can lock travel.
- Any constraints for hybrid room setup (AV + streaming) we should flag to venue?

Attendees: Emily Chen (Solstice, Sponsor), Tariq Al-Mansouri (OrionTech, customer), roughly 18 internal guests + 6 external partners. I can share a preliminary guest list.

Thanks — happy to jump on a quick call to align.

— Emily
Emily Chen
Director of Product, Solstice Inc.
[Attachment: guest_list_regional.csv (CSV, 12KB)]

From: Priya Natarajan <priya_natarajan@redwood.com>
To: Emily Chen <emily.chen@solsticeinc.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-09-02T10:04:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Intercontinental workshop planning

Emily —

Appreciate the details. We're available the week of Oct 11–15; Oct 13 for an in-person leadership session + Oct 14 for a virtual APAC-friendly drop-in should work. A few quick items from our side:

1) Tentative slots we propose (please pick one pair):
   - Option A: Oct 13 (UK) 09:00–12:30 BST — exec keynote + Q&A; Oct 14 13:00–15:00 SGT virtual drop-in
   - Option B: Oct 13 10:00–13:30 BST; Oct 14 10:00–12:00 SGT

2) Calendar holds: I'll create firm Google calendar holds visible to your ops and share the link.

3) AV constraints: we prefer a room with a single fixed camera + room mics and HDMI feed. If the venue can provide a clean RTMP stream endpoint we can record and route for APAC with low latency.

4) Logistics: please send final guest list and travel windows by Sep 10. We'll produce a staffing plan (host, engineer, account exec).

Attaching a preliminary floor plan we requested from a venue partner; Marissa will follow up on room specs and AV checklist.

Thanks — will schedule a 30-min alignment with your ops if that helps.

— Priya
Priya Natarajan
Customer Solutions | Redwood Inference
[Attachment: venue_floorplan_v3.pdf (PDF, 2.1MB)]

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: Priya Natarajan <priya_natarajan@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-09-03T08:21:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Intercontinental workshop planning

Folks —

Looping in logistics and drafting preliminary staffing + travel windows. Notes:
- Venue: Central London — we have the 09:00–13:00 slot tentatively blocked (Option A morning). Needs AV confirmation from venuehub.
- Staffing: Priya (lead), Marissa (onsite ops), Karthik (tech lead), Ben (account exec) — all tentatively available but Karthik requests a flight arriving Oct 12 evening to allow dry-run on Oct 13 at 07:30 BST.
- Travel windows: I've put a short spreadsheet in the shared drive with outbound/inbound flight options for Karthik and two engineers. Priya — can you confirm if Redwood will cover one-night hotel for the engineers?

Action items:
- Marissa: confirm AV endpoints with venuehub and attach the AV checklist. (cc: logistics@venuehub.com)
- Priya: publish calendar holds and share drives.
- Karthik: confirm whether earlier arrival is required for on-prem hardware checks.

Thanks — I will attach the guest list and preliminary travel itineraries once updated.

— Marissa
Marissa Cole
Director, Customer Events | Redwood Inference
[Attachment: prelim_travel_itineraries.xlsx (XLSX, 46KB)]

From: Priya Natarajan <priya_natarajan@redwood.com>
To: Emily Chen <emily.chen@solsticeinc.com>, Tariq Al-Mansouri <tariq@oriontech.co>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, logistics@venuehub.com
Date: 2026-09-05T14:33:00+01:00
Subject: Confirming holds + hybrid run cadence — Oct 13/14

Emily / Tariq —

Following internal confirmations, we're locking Option A as our preferred plan unless you flag a conflict:
- Oct 13 (London) 09:00–12:30 BST — Redwood in-person leadership session + on-stage Q&A
- Oct 14 13:00–15:00 SGT — virtual office hours for APAC attendees (hosted from London, recorded)

I've created mirrored calendar holds under the shared event: "Redwood x Solstice — Workshop (LON/Virtual)" and invited the Solstice ops alias. Link: https://calendar.google.com/event?action=TEMPLATE&dates=20261013/20261014&text=Redwood%20x%20Solstice%20Workshop

Practicals:
- AV: venuehub confirmed an RTMP endpoint and an HDMI-fed camera. Marissa will run a dry-run on Oct 12 at 07:30 BST.
- Travel: Redwood will cover one night for two engineers and one night for Karthik (travel policy code: TRV-RED-ENG). Finance/ben — please confirm cost center.
- Guest list: Emily, please share final names/legal names + dietary restrictions by Sep 10.

If that looks good I'll send a calendar update with locations and a short pre-read email (agenda + prereq checklist) on Sep 15.

Best —
Priya
Priya Natarajan
Customer Solutions | Redwood Inference

From: Emily Chen <emily.chen@solsticeinc.com>
To: Priya Natarajan <priya_natarajan@redwood.com>
Cc: Tariq Al-Mansouri <tariq@oriontech.co>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-09-07T16:45:00+02:00
Subject: Re: Confirming holds + hybrid run cadence — Oct 13/14

Thanks Priya — this is great and Option A works for Solstice ops. A couple quick points:

- Confirmed attendee updates: we have two additional legal reviewers joining the Oct 13 exec session; I've updated the guest_list_regional.csv and attached a second version.
- Pre-canary: can we do a 45-min technical dry run on Oct 12 at 08:00 BST (same day as your dry-run) to test our partner video bridge (OrionTech) + Redwood's RTMP stream? That would be helpful to prevent last-minute surprises.
- Invoice & PO: procurement will issue a PO next week; please send a draft invoice to procurement@solsticeinc.com with the cost center code TRV-RED-ENG to speed processing.

On the dry-run request: happy to mirror the call; Tariq — can your engineering lead join?

Appreciate the quick turn — we'll lock travel as soon as the calendar hold is firm.

— Emily
[Attachment: guest_list_regional_v2.csv (CSV, 14KB)]
